incidents.summary: Bangladesh reported five additional dengue deaths, bringing the toll to 389, along with 2,218 new hospitalizations. In Haryana, India, health authorities found mosquito larvae in over 112,000 homes and issued 53,000 notices for breeding violations. A separate article raised questions about government preparedness amid the ongoing surge.

logs.summary: Severe thunderstorms, tornadoes, and flash flooding impacted multiple regions across the United States from August 20–24, 2026. Confirmed tornadoes struck in Atlantic Beach (Long Island), Dover (Delaware), and York/Lancaster counties (Pennsylvania), while prolonged power outages from earlier storms left thousands without electricity in Gary, Indiana, for over a week. Widespread damage from downed trees, damaged homes, and flooding was reported in the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, and Midwest.

Rescue teams are searching for survivors while authorities warn of additional flood risks from a newly formed lake, and international aid is arriving to support relief efforts.

news.headline: Aug. 27: Flash Flooding Overwhelms Nepal, and Jury Deliberates in Lindsay Clancy’s Murder Trial
news.body: Devastating flash floods and mudslides wreaked havoc along the Nepal-China border this week, leaving hundreds dead and more than 1,000 missing. More than 500 foreigners are among the missing, including, by one estimate, roughly 65 Americans. NBC News correspondent Janis Mackey Frayer explains why the destruction happened without warning and what role climate change may have played. Then, jury deliberations are underway in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who killed her three young children. While Clancy doesn’t dispute the killings, her defense team is arguing that she shouldn’t be held criminally responsible because she was experiencing postpartum psychosis. But the prosecution insists she acted intentionally and deliberately. As the jury weighs a set of complex outcomes, NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris breaks down what evidence and testimony from the five-week trial could be key to reaching a verdict. Finally, 2026 could be the year of the foldable phone. Samsung and Google already have models on the market, and Apple is reportedly planning to drop its version in September. But are consumers willing to shell out $2,000 for a little extra screen? NBC News chief tech analyst Joanna Stern explains why the phones have appeal.

logs.summary:
On September 3, 2026, two Palestinian teens were killed in the occupied West Bank as Israeli settlers and snipers surrounded a village. Israeli forces bulldozed olive trees in the West Bank, while Prime Minister Netanyahu signaled plans to expand Israeli control over Gaza and the defence minister stated Israel still wants to remove Palestinians from Gaza. Additionally, a Gaza doctor continues to suffer torture in Israeli prison, and broader regional tensions escalated with Iranian missile and drone attacks targeting Kuwait.
On September 4, 2026, the UN raised 'ethnic cleansing' concerns over Israel's West Bank operation, reporting over 33,000 Palestinian refugees still displaced. Israeli police killed a Palestinian in Jerusalem after an alleged knife attack. Meanwhile, far-right minister Ben-Gvir outlined a plan for the forced expulsion of all Palestinians from Gaza.

Rachel caused street flooding and other damage in Mexico’s Baja California state. Four people died after Rachel swept through over the weekend and at least six were missing. logs.summary: On October 24, 2026, multiple strong earthquakes struck near Vanuatu, with the largest measuring magnitude 7.2 (USGS) at a shallow depth of 10 km. logs.summary:
Experts from China's Ministry of Natural Resources have warned that secondary geological hazards from the Nagqu earthquake may still pose risks over the medium to long term, despite limited immediate impacts. Volunteers continue relief efforts, with a photo story showing individuals serving stir-fried rice noodles to displaced residents. A rural boarding school reported that all 120 students safely evacuated within three minutes of the quake, crediting years of regular drills.
A fact-check report debunked a video claiming to show the Nagqu earthquake’s impact, revealing the footage is actually from Colombia. Meanwhile, large quantities of disaster relief supplies—including tents, prefabricated houses, and coal—have arrived in the quake-hit region, and authorities in Drachen county are racing to complete temporary housing for thousands of displaced residents.

logs.summary:
On October 25, 2026, a powerful earthquake struck near Japan's Bonin Islands (Ogasawara Islands) in the Pacific Ocean, with preliminary magnitudes reported between 6.3 and 7.0. The Japan Meteorological Agency stated no tsunami warnings were issued. The quake was attributed to tectonic plate movements along the Pacific "Ring of Fire."
A deep earthquake struck near Japan's Bonin Islands on October 25, with magnitudes reported between 6.5 and 7.0 and a depth of approximately 470–500 km. The tremor was felt over a wide area from the Kanto region to Tohoku, including Tokyo, but no tsunami warning was issued, and there was no tsunami threat to Hawaii.

logs.summary:
Cyclone Arnab has intensified over the Bay of Bengal and is expected to make landfall near the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, with sustained winds reaching up to 140 km/h, classified as a very severe cyclonic storm. Heavy rainfall is anticipated in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, prompting authorities to prepare for large-scale evacuations.
Andhra Pradesh is preparing to evacuate approximately 5.7 lakh people from vulnerable areas, and schools in Odisha have been closed as Cyclone Arnab approaches. West Bengal and other eastern states are on alert, with authorities coordinating response measures. The India Meteorological Department has issued specific district‑level warnings.

Cyclone Arnab made landfall along the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, bringing heavy rainfall, gusty winds up to 150 km/h, and widespread flooding. Over 137,000 people were evacuated, and flight and train services continued to be disrupted as the storm stalled near the coast.
Cyclone Arnab has turned deadly, with at least three people killed in Andhra Pradesh and dozens of houses damaged, along with crop destruction. Over 900 babies were born in Odisha during the cyclone, with parents naming some after the storm. Additionally, Telangana has offered support to Andhra Pradesh for restoration efforts.

logs.summary:
Cyclone Arnab has weakened further post-landfall, with the IMD forecasting it to move north‑northwestwards and weaken completely by midnight. Odisha evacuated over 31,000 people across seven districts as heavy rains continued. Meanwhile, Nepal issued a 36‑hour alert for heavy rain and snowfall from the weakening system, though the storm is expected to lose tropical cyclone intensity before reaching the region.
The death toll from Cyclone Arnab has risen to six, with heavy post‑cyclone rains flooding two Odisha districts and prompting Indian Coast Guard helicopter rescues for marooned villagers. The India Meteorological Department issued a fresh depression alert over the South Andaman Sea, while Arnab's remnants continue to bring heavy rain to Chhattisgarh, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh.
